EmailTemplate.description: This email template is used for sending the KYC Abandonment Email to the customers.
EmailTemplate.name: KYC Abandonment Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Please complete your KYC Application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!KYC_Response__c.FirstName__c},
Our records show that your KYC application is still in progress.
To complete your profile, please click the below link. You can pick up exactly where you left off, and the remaining steps should only take a few minutes.
{!KYC_Response__c.Resume_Link__c}
Completing the KYC process is a regulatory requirement, and we appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.
If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact us on or call us on 800 MODON (800 66366) or email customercare@modon.com
Best regards,
Modon
